title: Use io.StringIO as a safe in-memory file, write and read the word Python1. (Challenge 1)
description: Use io.StringIO as a safe in-memory file, write and read the word Python1.
hints: Identify the main Python concept: file handling.
Write a small, direct solution and check indentation.
Compare each printed line with the expected output.
solution:
from io import StringIO
file = StringIO()
file.write("Python1")
file.seek(0)
print(file.read())
explanation: This exercise practices file handling. The solution uses the relevant Python feature and prints the required result.
commonMistakes: Forgetting correct indentation or punctuation.
Printing extra text that changes the expected output.
